summarize_flores_languages: summarize the flores_languages list of 211 language-script code strings from the FLORES benchmark dataset
review_flores_languages: review the flores_languages list to check for duplicate or missing language-script entries
test_flores_languages: test that the flores_languages list contains only valid BCP-47 language-script code strings
refactor_flores_languages: refactor the flores_languages list into a sorted deduplicated set of language-script codes
build_flores_languages_lookup: build a lookup mapping from each flores_languages code to its human-readable language name
